title: Tight spectral conditions for the Hamiltonicity of $K_{1,r}$-free split graphs
summary: The Hamiltonicity and related subjects of split graphs, and in particular $K_{1,r}$-free split graphs with $r\ge 3$ received much attention. Dai et al. [Discrete Math. 345 (2022) 112826] conjectured that every $(r-1)$-connected $K_{1,r}$-free split graph is Hamiltonian. They proved the case when $r=4$, and earlier Renjith and Sadagopan [Int. J. Found. Comput. Sci. 33 (2022) 1--32] proved the case when $r=3$.
